verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
However high the north is from the south
The measure of the Savior's love for us
However far the east is from the west
The measure of my Redeemer's love

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
How deep, how wide, how vast, how high
Is the infinite love of Christ
How strong, how sure, sufficient, secure
Is the infinite love of Christ
And it's infinitely mine

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
However deep the ocean of my sin
My Savior's love is so much deeper still
However far the chasm I have made
He closed the gap, rising from the grave

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
How marvelous, how wonderful
And my song shall ever be
How marvelous, how wonderful
Is my Savior's love for me
